<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {
    "name": "forceMount",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when\ncontrolling animation with Vue animation libraries.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "trapFocus",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, focus cannot escape the <code>Content</code> via keyboard,\npointer, or a programmatic focus.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disableOutsidePointerEvents",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, hover/focus/click interactions will be disabled on elements outside\nthe <code>DismissableLayer</code>.   },
  {
    "name": "asChild",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.</p>\n<p>Read our <a href=\"https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/composition\">Composition</a> guide for more details.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "as",
    "type": "AsTag | Component",
    "default": "\"div\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by <code>asChild</code>.</p>"
  }
]' />

<ApiTable kind="events" :items='[
  {
    "name": "escapeKeyDown",
    "payload": "[event: KeyboardEvent]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when the escape key is down.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "pointerDownOutside",
    "payload": "[event: PointerDownOutsideEvent]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when a <code>pointerdown</code> event happens outside of the <code>DismissableLayer</code>.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "focusOutside",
    "payload": "[event: FocusOutsideEvent]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when the focus moves outside of the <code>DismissableLayer</code>.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "interactOutside",
    "payload": "[event: PointerDownOutsideEvent | FocusOutsideEvent]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when an interaction happens outside the <code>DismissableLayer</code>.\nSpecifically, when a <code>pointerdown</code> event happens outside or focus moves outside of it.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "openAutoFocus",
    "payload": "[event: Event]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "closeAutoFocus",
    "payload": "[event: Event]",
    "description": "<p>Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.\nCan be prevented.</p>"
  }
]' />
